title: Optical visibility by elevation band (optical_visibility_by_band 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe optical_visibility_by_band 1.0.0 for Ait Bouguemez valley catchment: for each of the three elevation bands and each of the 84 months of 2019-01 to 2025-12, the share of the band's 10 m cells with a clear Sentinel-2 observation (at least one date, and at least three), and the winter (December to March, 28 months) summary. Upper band, winter, at least one date: 0.1895 to 0.9855, median 0.4731, 3 of 28 months at or above 0.9. Observation.

A clear share counts cells that have at least one (or three) Sentinel-2 dates not classed as cloud, cloud shadow, snow or water in the month; it says how often the band was seen, not how much of it was covered by snow or cloud, and the files do not say which of the two hid a cell. The shares depend on the Sentinel-2 scene classification of each date, which makes errors on thin cloud, snow edges and shadow; they are observations of the classification, not of the ground. Bands are elevation terciles that organise sampling; they are not vegetation types, grazing zones or management boundaries. Only the months of 2019 to 2025 that the Sentinel-2 monthly series holds are covered, 28 winter months.

siterra:dataset.access_route: Earth Search STAC API https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/, collection sentinel-2-l2a (legacy), COGs on sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com read by window

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

validity.label: at least one clear Sentinel-2 date in the month (a monthly median exists)
at least three clear Sentinel-2 dates in the month

operation_order: Bands: the three equal-area elevation terciles of the terrain strata bundle (band 1 below 2316.8 m, 2 to below 2815.2 m, 3 from 2815.2 m up), each over the 10 m analysis cells inside the frozen polygon

A month's cells: for each month from 2019-01 to 2025-12, the monthly Sentinel-2 composite of the NDVI bundle: median.tif (NDVI median, NaN where no date kept the cell) and count.tif (the number of dates that kept the cell); a date keeps a cell where the Scene Classification Layer is 4 (vegetation) or 5 (not vegetated) and the bands have data; cloud, shadow, snow and water classes drop it

Clear share: for each band, month and validity definition, the number of the band's cells that are valid divided by the number of the band's cells, to 4 decimals. any_date (primary): the median is a number (equivalently count at least 1); three_dates: count at least 3

Winter: the months December, January, February and March (28 months from 2019-01 to 2025-12). For each band and definition: the lowest, median, highest clear share over the winter months, the number of winter months at or above 0.9 and at or above 0.5, and the winter months with their shares

Acceptance checks, all stored with the bundle: the three bands' cell counts sum to the number of 10 m cells inside the polygon; every month has median.tif and count.tif on the strata grid; for every month the any_date valid count equals the count of cells with count at least 1; the clear shares of the upper band in winter reproduce the figures named in the place configuration (minimum 0.19, median 0.4731, maximum 0.985, 3 months at or above 0.9, 11 at or above 0.5, December 2023 0.971, January 2024 0.947, February 2024 0.985, to the digits given); the sha256 of every input file is stored; two runs give identical files apart from the computed time

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: Recomputed from the stored monthly files. The three bands' cells sum to 4173603 against 4173603 cells inside the polygon (True); 84 months present on the strata grid (0 grid mismatches); the any_date count differs from the count of cells with at least one date in 0 months. The upper band's winter shares (28 months, any_date): lowest 0.1895, median 0.4731, highest 0.9855, 3 at or above 0.9 (2023-12, 2024-01, 2024-02), 11 at or above 0.5; each equals the figure named in the place configuration: {'lowest': True, 'median': True, 'highest': True, 'at_or_above_high': True, 'at_or_above_half': True, 'winter_months': True, 'named_months': True}. The stricter three_dates reading of the same band: lowest 0.0467, median 0.3289, highest 0.9028, 1 at or above 0.9, 8 at or above 0.5. The sha256 of all 168 input files is stored. The whole computation run twice in one process is identical: True.

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Clear share is a fraction of the band's 10 m cells (0 to 1, 4 decimals); the bands are the strata's equal-area elevation terciles (2316.8 m and 2815.2 m); months are calendar months of the Sentinel-2 composites; winter is December to March.

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: A share of 0 means no cell of the band had a clear date that month; nothing is stored as missing (every month and band has a value). Cells outside the polygon are not counted in any band.

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: The Sentinel-2 and Copernicus DEM notices are in siterra:attribution.

siterra:checks.name: visual_inspection_sample
siterra:checks.detail: Rendered the stored shares as a strip, one row per elevation band and one column per month from 2019-01 to 2025-12, with the winter months marked (visibility.png): the clear share is near 1 in every band from April to November, falls in the winter months of every year, and falls furthest in the upper band, whose winter columns are the darkest and whose three clearest winter months (December 2023, January and February 2024) stand out as light; the lower band stays light throughout. The winter marks line up with the dark columns. The cell classification of each date was not checked against imagery here.
